== Notes ==
* The shadow step and the hex are considered separate effects:
**If the shadow step fails (i.e. if the target is in an inaccessible location), the target will still be affected by the movement speed hex.
**If the hex fails (i.e. the target is under the effects of [[Hex Breaker]]), you will still shadow step to the target.
